selection: Largest inspect-tier paired-edge/census disagreements across title, credits and stats; selected after full-set scoring for diagnostic review, not fitting or validation.

cards.name: Pearled Unicorn
cards.note: Credits and stats placement visibly improve. Stats remain thin relative to the scan; source 2/2 is confirmed.

cards.name: Veteran Bodyguard
cards.note: Stats are visibly lower/right, but now look a little small/thin; census falls. Keep as a font-size/shape review case across white cards.

cards.name: Phantasmal Forces
cards.note: Title is better positioned but remains a little narrow. Credits and lower/right numeric stats visibly improve; fine glyph strokes differ.

cards.name: Serendib Efreet
cards.note: Existing known printing routing defect: the scan has a green frame while semantic blue chooses a blue plate. This dominates local appearance; exact printing-specific frame routing is needed.

cards.name: Animate Dead
cards.note: Only paired-edge title regression over .02. Placement moves toward the left edge, but the pale strokes look weak/broken on the dark frame. Revisit glyph interior treatment across black cards with a new reserved cohort; no per-card offset.

cards.name: Ley Druid
cards.note: Left credits and lower/right stats visibly improve. Artist glyph weight/width and frame texture differ; do not fit scan-specific coordinates.

cards.name: Ornithopter
cards.note: Title and stats are better positioned. The letter-edge treatment is thin and the original artifact texture/gray lettering still differs.

cards.name: Sol Ring
cards.note: Credits move to the correct left region and gain ©. Font width and pale/dark stroke balance still differ; census drops despite higher edge overlap.

next: Keep the shared placement gains. Investigate weak/broken interior glyph strokes on dark backgrounds and numeric glyph size using new reserved component images before any further style changes. Correct printing type/mana/stat source fields separately before fitting those components.
